crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

people.name: Mahalalel
people.line: Descendant of Seth; ancestor of Noah

translations.web: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
translations.bsb: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
translations.kjv: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
translations.asv: and all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
